hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: USAGE TRIPWIRE (harness/swarm/HANDOFF_NOW exists): PAUSE ALL WORK NOW AND WRITE A RESUME DOCUMENT so the work can be relaunched after the usage reset. Do NOT start any new build, test, sim, render, routing, research or code edit. (1) Let nothing new launch. Wait for a job that is already running only if it finishes within about 2 minutes; otherwise stop the jobs YOU started, by exact PID only, and list them. Never touch processes you did not start. (2) Commit ALL your work in progress on YOUR OWN branch in your own worktree (machine git identity, no AI attribution) and push that branch (never force, never to main or dev unless you are the integrator). Never commit *.kicad_prl or files over 50 MB. If a commit is impossible, leave the work in the worktree and say exactly where. (3) Release every slot you hold (bash harness/swarm/locks/slot.sh release <slots>) and the MERGE_LOCK if you hold it; never delete other lock directories. (4) Write your resume document, named with the date and time first so the folder sorts by date: harness/swarm/resume_<YYYY-MM-DD>/RESUME_<YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM>_<lane>.md (template: references/resume-doc.md of the hardware-in-the-loop skill). Contents: goal and brief; branch, worktree, last pushed SHA; every owner decision and constraint you were given; DONE (SHAs, files, numbers, images); IN PROGRESS with its exact state; results so far; BLOCKED and why; dependencies on other lanes; exact next steps; the gates that must run at the end; open owner questions; write-offs (what is abandoned and why). Write it from what you already know; do not research more. (5) Then stop and return a short report naming the document path and your last SHA. THE LEAD (main session) writes RESUME_<YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM>_lead.md in the same folder (every owner decision, every lane's state, the relaunch order) and appends a 'Where I stopped' section to the active plan.
